command: cd /home/agent/workspace && ACTUAL=$(sha256sum release/artifact.txt | awk '{print $1}') && STORED=$(awk '{print $1}' release/digest.txt) && MAPPED=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('release/mapping.json'))['1.0.0'])") && echo "actual:  $ACTUAL" && echo "stored:  $STORED" && echo "mapped:  $MAPPED" && [ "$ACTUAL" = "$STORED" ] && echo "digest.txt matches artifact" || echo "digest.txt MISMATCH" ; [ "$ACTUAL" = "$MAPPED" ] && echo "mapping.json matches artifact" || echo "mapping.json MISMATCH"
intent: Recompute digest and compare with digest.txt and mapping.json
